guideDescription: A fresh-level-80 path into Cat Form priorities, Energy pooling, bleed maintenance, dungeon utility, and later raid progression.

mechanics.label: Forms
mechanics.use: Stay in Cat Form for the damage job and change form only for a deliberate movement, survival, or utility reason.

mechanics.label: Resources
mechanics.use: Pool Energy, build combo points, and spend only when Savage Roar and Rip remain safe.

mechanics.label: Bleeds
mechanics.use: Maintain Rake and a strong five-combo-point Rip only on targets that will live long enough.

mechanics.label: Survival
mechanics.use: Use Barkskin, Survival Instincts, movement, off-healing, and emergency Bear Form without abandoning the assigned DPS job.

talent.name: Fresh-80 self-contained Cat baseline
talent.summary: Use the fully allocated Cat build for Savage Roar, Rip, Shred, Energy, mobility, and solo utility. Treat bearweaving and encounter-specific glyph swaps as later options.

pageDescriptions.quickStart: Start at level 80 with Cat Form, Savage Roar, bleed priorities, cap assumptions, and a practical dungeon-ready checklist.
pageDescriptions.playing: Manage Energy, combo points, Savage Roar, bleeds, positioning, movement, target life, and utility as one priority system.
pageDescriptions.setup: Install the 0/55/16 build, glyphs, form controls, original-client macros, addons, and tracking.
pageDescriptions.building: Build reliable melee stats first, then compare Strength, Agility, haste, critical strike, and later Armor Penetration sets.
pageDescriptions.equipping: Target normal and heroic dungeon, reputation, crafted, emblem, catch-up, ToC, ICC, and Ruby Sanctum upgrades.
pageDescriptions.raiding: Handle positional uptime, bleeds, target swaps, interrupts, battle resurrection, and encounter responsibilities by mode.

serverNote: Standard original-client WotLK 3.3.5a behavior is the baseline. Verify Omen of Clarity, Rip extensions, Savage Roar scaling, bearweaving, Armor Penetration, and encounter-specific immunities on Hellscream.
footer: Unofficial player-made Hellscream guide. Verify live tooltips, raid assignments, and server scripting.
